description.value: Slumber Lodge is a motel situated in Hope, BC, at the junction of Highway 1 in the Fraser Canyon gateway, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists traversing southern BC. The property has a website listing rooms and amenities, though specific services are not detailed in available content. Its highway access location positions it conveniently for touring cyclists moving between the Lower Mainland and the Interior.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is a sparse contact page for Slumber Lodge Motel in Hope, BC, confirming the address (250 Fort St, Hope, BC V0X 1L0) and providing phone numbers absent from OSM. No bike-specific amenities, storage, laundry, breakfast, or tools are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. Wi-Fi is supported by the OSM tag internet_access=wlan and not contradicted by the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Slumber Lodge' but the website consistently uses 'Slumber Lodge Motel' — OSM record may need a name update.
OSM record has no phone number; phone sourced from website only.
Website content is very limited (single contact page scraped); amenities page content was not available, leaving most fields unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate motel in a cycling-relevant location on Highway 1 in Hope, BC, but the website content is too sparse to confirm either required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure). Direct outreach needed before including in the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two phone numbers on website: (604) 869-5666 (local) and 1-800-757-7766 (toll-free). Community listed as 'Unknown / Lower Mainland & Fraser Valley' but the address is Hope, BC, which is in the Fraser Valley.
